integrity: An analytical proof establishes global extrema; a standalone exact-rational and independent convex-hull checker provides finite corroboration rather than an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification only for the two-square latitude normal family; no claim of optimization among all spherical three-designs or convex bodies. Related record-level comparisons carry residual priority risk.
title: Sharp projection-body volume in a twisted eight-normal spherical three-design family
